name: Cloudflare
description: Skills for the Cloudflare developer platform: Workers, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, MCP servers, Wrangler CLI, and web performance.
longDescription:
Ships **13 skills**, **2 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (13): `agents-sdk` (Build AI agents on Cloudflare Workers using the Agents SDK), `cloudflare` (Comprehensive Cloudflare platform skill covering Workers, Pages, storage (KV, D1, R2), AI (Workers AI, Vectorize, Agents SDK), feature…), `cloudflare-email-service` (Send and receive transactional emails with Cloudflare Email Service (Email Sending + Email Routing)), `cloudflare-one` (Guides Cloudflare One Zero Trust and SASE work across Access, Gateway, WARP, Tunnel, Cloudflare WAN, DLP, CASB, device…), `cloudflare-one-migrations` (Plans migrations from Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Palo Alto, legacy VPN, SWG, or SASE stacks to Cloudflare One), `durable-objects` (Create and review Cloudflare Durable Objects), `sandbox-migrate-to-next` (Use when porting a Cloudflare Sandbox app from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to @cloudflare/sandbox@next (Sandbox SDK 1.0 preview), or when…), `sandbox-next` (Use when building or changing Cloudflare Sandbox apps on @cloudflare/sandbox@next (Sandbox SDK 1.0 preview)—code execution, AI runners, interpreters,…), and 5 more
- **Commands** (2): `build-agent` (Build an AI agent on Cloudflare using the Agents SDK), `build-mcp` (Build a remote MCP server on Cloudflare using McpAgent)
- **MCP servers** (1): `cloudflare`

Installs with `claude plugin install cloudflare@claude-plugins-official` from `cloudflare/skills`.
